page: OVHcloud l40s-360 is a dedicated GPU-accelerated cloud server designed for compute-heavy parallel workloads, machine learning inference, and complex graphics processing. The instance runs on KVM virtualization over an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9124 processor, delivering 60 physical cores and 60 vCPUs clocked at 2.75 GHz without multithreading overhead. Memory capacity is allocated at 360 GB of system RAM, providing an even ratio of 6.0 GB per core. The hardware profile is distinguished by four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L40S GPUs, granting a total of 192 GB of VRAM across the accelerators. Local fast-tier storage is provided by a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and external connectivity operates with a 25 Gbps baseline network throughput.

Empirical benchmarks demonstrate top-quartile results across CPU-bound and instruction-level evaluations. The server logged 95,991.39 in multi-core stress-ng tests and 70,150.86 in PassMark CPU calculations, both falling within the top 25 percent tier. In extended CPU instruction routines, cryptography, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, the configuration showed similar top-tier execution speed. Clang software compilation reached 49,727.0 points in Geekbench testing alongside 57,951.0 in ray tracing tasks, reflecting robust vector math and compilation capability. In contrast, standard memory bandwidth tests registered mid-tier figures, with uncached read operations at 97.71 GB/s and write throughput at 38.02 GB/s.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the l40s-360 delivers exceptional acceleration density by combining four enterprise-grade L40S GPUs with 60 dedicated host cores on a single platform. A potential consideration is the compact 400 GB NVMe storage footprint, which necessitates remote block or object storage for datasets exceeding local disk bounds, as well as the absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The balanced ratio of CPU compute, extensive GPU memory, and high network throughput makes this server well configured for large language model inference, batch video rendering, generative AI pipelines, and large-scale parallel simulations.
description: OVHcloud l40s-360 is a high-density GPU-accelerated cloud instance engineered for computationally intensive graphics, machine learning inference, and data-parallel workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it provides 60 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor running at 2.75 GHz, accompanied by 360 GB of system memory at 6.0 GB per core. The hardware configuration integrates four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L40S GPUs, delivering an aggregate 192 GB of GDDR6 VRAM to handle large-scale model execution and rendering tasks. Local high-speed storage is provisioned via a 400 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 25 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results reflect top-tier multi-threaded compute and instruction performance, including exceptional scores in stress-ng multi-core testing, bzip3 decompression, and extended vector workloads. The instance offers significant compute and accelerator density within a single node, making it suitable for distributed deep learning inference, 3D rendering pipelines, video processing, and enterprise scientific computing.
